title: Belgium – Advertising and marketing services – European Potato Promotion Campaign
description_excerpt: From 2020 to 2025, VLAM, CNIPT, Bord Bia and Europatat collaborated on the European fresh potato promotion campaign “Potatoes, prepare to be surprised – Europe’s favourite since 1536”. Building on this experience, the four organisations are joining forces for a new three-year information and promotion campaign, co-funded by the European Union. The new campaign offers an opportunity to develop a fresh and distinctive creative concept. While lessons from the previous campaign can serve as inspiration, we expect an original, new approach, without being bound by the branding, slogan or visual identity of the previous campaign. The new campaign wants to stimulate the consumption of fresh potatoes at EU level and more specifically in three countries, i.e. Belgium (Flanders), France and Ireland. Target group of the campaign is people between 25 and 44 years old The communication objective of the new campaign is to highlight the ease of use (convenience) and versatility of fresh potatoes (pleasure) and their place in a contemporary lifestyle and a healthy, balanced and sustainable diet. The campaign activities include a mix of promotional activities, some implemented in all target countries, others in 1 or more target countries.
